module: Lua interface for OpenXR virtual reality (VR headset). Drives the C++ engine (global object OpenXR): enabling/disabling with a welcome dialog, session state received from the engine (stateChanged), recentering, error handling, and a debug ImGui window (2D display settings, CEF UI in the headset, anchoring, debug mode, resolutions, FOV, IPD). The extension unloads itself on deactivation. Global: render_openxr.
usage:
extensions.render_openxr.toggle()   -- disabled -> welcome -> enabled -> disabled
extensions.render_openxr.center()   -- recenters the view (ctrl+numpad5)
if extensions.render_openxr.isSessionRunning() then ... end
notes: stateString: 'disabled', 'welcome' (confirmation dialog shown) or 'enabled'. setStateUI('welcome') only opens the dialog with the OK button if the adapter is Vulkan or Direct3D12; otherwise only a cancel button is offered ("no Vulkan" text).
The Lua callbacks of the dialog buttons are strings executed by the UI: `extensions.render_openxr.closeWelcome(true|false)`.

M.state is the table received from the C++ engine via stateChanged(state); the UI is notified by guihooks 'OpenXRStateChanged' when one of the tracked fields changes (enabled, sessionRunning, headsetActive, systemName, targetRefreshRate, renderedWidth/Height, recommendedWidth/Height, sourceCount, activeSourceCount, poseValidSourceCount, inputSourcesKey). The sourceCount… fields and the getInputSourceStates/getSourcePoseStates accessors are commented out (TODO, API not finalized).
onPreRender (and not onUpdate) is used deliberately: core_camera runs at preRender, so OpenXR must come after it to avoid a one-frame pose lag (hence the dependency on core_camera).

Persisted settings (via settings): openXRuiEnabled, openXRuiMode, openXRwindowViewMode, openXRdebugEnabled, openXRquadCompositionEnabled (default false), plus openXRimguiEnabled (read only); changing debug mode during a session restarts OpenXR.
The debug ImGui window is only drawn if the openXRimguiEnabled setting is true and the session is running; closing the window disables OpenXR.
Shortcuts announced in the debug UI: ctrl+numpad0 (enable/disable), ctrl+numpad5 (center).
If enable fails on the C++ side, a simple debug log is emitted and the state goes back to 'disabled'.

cefDialogOpen.desc: true while the welcome dialog is open.

state.desc: OpenXR state received from the engine: systemName ('?' by default), enabled, sessionRunning, sessionState, renderedWidth/Height, recommendedWidth/Height, supportedWidth/Height, supportedLayers, fov0hz/fov0vt/fov1hz/fov1vt, ipd (m), currentRefreshRate/targetRefreshRate…

openXRuiEnabled.desc: ImGui BoolPtr of the openXRuiEnabled setting (created by loadPointerSettings).

openXRuiMode.desc: IntPtr of the openXRuiMode setting (UI anchoring: 0 room, 1 head).

openXRwindowViewMode.desc: IntPtr of the 2D window display mode: 0 empty, 1 between the eyes, 2 left eye, 3 right eye.

onPreRender.desc: Pre-render hook: calls the current update function (onUpdate when OpenXR is enabled, otherwise nothing).

onInit.desc: Initialization hook: sets the extension to manual unload and loads the settings.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Settings change hook: re-reads the OpenXR settings, restarts OpenXR if debug mode changes during a session, and regenerates the UI curvature (OpenXR.generateUiCurvature) if OpenXR is active.

stateChanged.desc: Called by the C++ engine on every OpenXR state change: updates M.state (the target refresh rate keeps the maximum seen; an infinite rate is brought back to 0), synchronizes stateString with enabled and notifies the UI.

setStateUI.desc: Changes the state of the OpenXR interface: 'welcome' opens the dialog, 'enabled' activates OpenXR.setEnable(true) (falls back to 'disabled' on failure), 'disabled' turns it off and unloads the extension; any other value is an error (disables). Records a player action "set VR state …".

toggle.desc: Advances the state: disabled -> welcome; welcome -> enabled; enabled -> disabled.

center.desc: Recenters the VR view. Without argument, recenters once (OpenXR.centerNow); with a value, enables/disables continuous recentering when value > 0.2 (OpenXR.centerContinuous).

value.desc: Analog value of an input action (inferred from code).

isSessionRunning.desc: Indicates whether an OpenXR session is running.

updateUI.desc: Sends 'OpenXRStateChanged' to the UI if a tracked field changed, or if forced (then also logs the state).

closeWelcome.desc: Closing of the welcome dialog (called by its buttons): enable=true enables OpenXR, otherwise disables it.

errorDetected.desc: Called by the engine on an OpenXR error: logs the error and shows an error toast with the translation `ui.openXR.errors.<err>`.
